thesis: Royal Assassin creates a zone of control rather than raw card advantage: any tapped creature can die, forcing the opponent to reconsider attacks, activated abilities, and tap costs.

playbook.role: Keep the Assassin untapped and protect it until the opponent commits a target. Effects that tap creatures or grant haste expand its reach beyond ordinary combat.
